title: Surreal Geometric Guardian
description: A large abstract geometric figure with a split multicolored face, one yellow eye, and black lips stands with arms raised in the center. A vibrant green dog wearing an ornate harness stands on geometric blocks in front, with a wooden mountain house, cascading rainbow waterfall, classical ruins, and a dramatic pink-blue sky with a setting sun visible behind.
prompt: A large abstract geometric humanoid figure with a split face composed of purple, orange, green and white shapes, one large yellow eye, black lips, and raised hands stands in the foreground. A bright green dog with a detailed patterned harness stands alert on colorful geometric stone blocks. Behind them is a wooden house perched on a rocky mountain peak with a rainbow waterfall cascading down, flanked by classical Greek ruins under a dramatic sky with pink clouds and a glowing sunset.
